text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens in a loose heap on the left half of the plate: ruffled light green leaves, darker burgundy-red edged leaves, and thin red-tinged stems, with small red pieces (possibly radish slices) scattered through; leaves look dry-to-lightly dressed with a faint sheen, holding their shape, covering roughly 35% of the plate footprint and about 4-5 cm deep | 110

ITEM 2 | Pale golden-beige sliced meat, three overlapping slices arranged in a fan on the right side of the plate; smooth-to-slightly-grainy surface with light tan browning and small darker flecks on edges, moist-looking with a slight sheen, each slice about 7 cm long by 4-5 cm wide and roughly 1-1.5 cm thick, firm and holding shape | 160

ITEM 3 | Small dark green florets of broccoli tucked between the salad and the meat slices, bright green with darker stems, slightly dry-looking, about 4-5 cm across in a cluster and roughly 2 cm high | 25

ITEM 4 | Small amount of brownish crumbly residue or seasoning bits along the edge of the meat slices near the right side, dry and granular, about 1 cm across | 3
